title: Guide Your Audience: Signposting and Transitions
objective: Students learn phrases that help listeners follow a scientific presentation.
phrases: This brings me to the conclusion.
outcomes: Use signposting to move between sections.
Introduce background, methods, results, and conclusion.
activity: Signpost relay: each student receives one slide transition and must say it naturally before the next speaker continues.
example: After methods, a presenter says: “Now that I have explained the experimental design, let us look at the main results.”
